title: logreach one public route per repo (private hosts excluded, pick order)
requirement: Query one public route per repo; private hosts (s2s) never; pick ms + repo-named prefix. REQ-0078 (RAW-00629, RAW-00631)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 one route per repo unless the finding names a host
AC3 pick order prefer_host, repo-named prefix, name, file order; VNW jobseekers -> ms /jobseekers/
AC4 no keys / single-route repos unchanged; Upzi identical
AC5 VNW g01 rebuild gaps=0, QA PASS, changed verdicts listed
AC6 stored map: 1 public domain + 1 route per repo (extras logreach:false + note); --check-routes validates the map, fails on >1 (RAW-00632/00633)
